items.title: Ed Allen Interview, 1961-01-14
items.q: He was our first teacher teacher in the group... Professor Blue was able to come around in Thursday... Professor Blue didn't want to be bothered. He taught you how to read.

ctx.x: Yeah, we had a band teacher. Yeah, good, it's picking it up. I wasn't sure if it was getting it. You had a teacher for your band, what did you have, a little kid band?

Well we had a kid band, but then we started from kids, but we were in the range until some of them up in the 20s before that. Colonel, who was at them, was not a pitching band, an organization band, see? And we played for, we weren't allowed to play military music. And we had a fellow named Thorn Blue, a clinic, I guess you know him. His father used to teach us. He was a wonderful trumpet player. And that old lady called him cornet. And he was our first teacher teacher in the group. But coming up in the group I…
So you were playing professionally about what year? Well professionally I would say back
